name: Answers a Spanish email from English articles, in Spanish

knowledge.title: Refund policy
knowledge.content: Refunds go to the original payment method within 5 business days of us receiving the return.

knowledge.title: Shipping times
knowledge.content: Standard shipping takes 3 to 7 business days.
